requiredPhrases: tarifs indiqués sont accessibles depuis l’opérateur Electromaps

notes: The per-minute components are triggered by total connection duration after the published threshold, not specifically by the end of energy delivery.
The SYDED page states that the displayed tariffs are accessible via Electromaps. Users of another operator/eMSP must check that provider's own retail price.
The regional BFC page currently corroborates the SYDED/Doubs 22 kW tier and roaming context, while the SYDED operator page remains the authoritative source for the full 22/50/100 kW grid.
Third-party roaming prices must therefore remain separate from the SYDED/Electromaps published tariff grid.
summaryLines: SYDED Doubs publishes its current charging tariffs as accessible via Electromaps.
22 kW: 0.40 EUR/kWh plus 0.02 EUR/min after 3 hours connected.
50 kW: 0.50 EUR/kWh plus 0.03 EUR/min after 90 minutes connected.
100 kW: 0.60 EUR/kWh plus 0.05 EUR/min after 60 minutes connected.
The time component is based on connection duration, not only post-charge occupancy.
The regional BFC page corroborates the Doubs 22 kW tier; the SYDED page is the source of truth for the full tariff grid.
Other operator/eMSP retail prices may differ and remain separate.
